cell.source: Skip the guided defaults and service choices. You’ll still connect your media server before setup can finish.

cell.rationale: The caller presents this as the description beneath the guided/advanced setup choice. The current second sentence is ungrammatical (`ستقوم لا يزال بتوصيل`). The proposal replaces it with natural wording that preserves the source meaning: connecting the media server is still required before setup can finish. The first sentence is clear in this setup context; the proposal is accepted as written.
